hints.text: An exponent inside a log SLIDES OUT to the front: $\log(A^n) = n \cdot \log A$.

explanation: The power rule lets the exponent slide out front: $\log_2(8^3) = 3 \cdot \log_2(8)$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Just multiply it out
steps: Now ask: $2$ to what power gives $512$? Count doublings: $2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, 512$.
That is $9$ doublings, so the answer is $9$.
